TD4 は A・B・OUT・PC の4 bit レジスタと C フラグ、16バイ: TD4 has four 4-bit registers—A, B, OUT, and PC—a carry flag C, and a 16-byte instruction ROM. The upper four bits of an instruction select the operation; the lower four hold an immediate value. MUX selects A, B, the input, or zero; ALU adds the immediate; and DECODER selects the destination. Here we follow the terminals between modules without expanding their internal transistors.

Combinational circuits recalculate whenever an input reaches a terminal, and their results travel along the next wires. A value arriving at a register and that register storing it are separate events.

Zoom in to follow individual lanes; hover over a terminal to see its bit index and H/L state. Hexadecimal values are a reading aid. The source can already have a new value while the destination still has the old one. Select a wire to compare every bit at both ends, then follow its cause back to the input arrival that produced the change.

Its two read ports produce separate values simultaneously, and its one write port stores the result on a clock edge. An instruction can place its result elsewhere while preserving its inputs.
r0 は常に0で、書き込みは捨てます。CMP r1, r2 は SUB r0,: r0 always reads as zero and discards writes. CMP r1, r2 is an alias for SUB r0, r1, r2. It keeps the flags without storing the difference, so comparison needs no separate data path. The roles of r6 and r7 as SP/LR are conventions used later; here they are general-purpose registers.
ADDI r1, 3 は r1 自身に3を加える2オペランド形式です。3本のレジ: ADDI r1, 3 uses two operands and adds 3 to r1 itself. Three register numbers plus a large immediate would not fit into 16 bits, so immediate instructions share a source and destination register. The separate ISA guide explains the bit layout.
Z は結果が0、C は桁上がり（減算では借り）、N は結果の最上位 bit、V: Z means the result is zero; C means carry (borrow for subtraction); N is the result's top bit; and V indicates signed overflow. Signed comparison cannot use N alone. For example, 32767 − (−1) looks negative in 16 bits, so JLT tests whether N and V differ.
分岐先は PC + 1 + 符号付きオフセットです。PC+1 と分岐先を並行に作: The branch target is PC + 1 + a signed offset. PC+1 and the branch target are calculated in parallel, and NEXT PC chooses between them using the saved flags and branch condition. This is a single-cycle implementation: one continuous combinational circuit prepares everything from instruction fetch to writeback. Even if the path is long, the next clock does not arrive halfway through it.

FT16 はロード/ストア型です。ADD はレジスタ間で計算し、メモリから取り出: FT16 is a load/store architecture. ADD operates on registers; LD brings data from memory and ST writes it back. To process an array, keep an address in a register and repeat LD → calculation → ST. Instructions and data are both 16-bit words in the same RAM.
番地はバイト単位ではなく語単位です。r1 = 0x0080 なら [r1+1]: Addresses count words, not bytes. With r1 = 0x0080, [r1+1] refers to the next 16-bit word at 0x0081. Instruction PC also increases by one. RAM has 512 words, and the program must keep its code and data from overlapping.
ストアの番地・データ・書き込み許可: Store address, data, and write enable
ST r2, [r1+3] は r1 と3から保存先の番地を作り、r2 の中身を: ST r2, [r1+3] forms a destination address from r1 and 3, then stores r2 there. ADDR carries the address; the other RF output carries the value to write. For LD, the same address calculation is followed by a MEMORY read, and WRITEBACK selects that value for the destination register.
読み出し・書き込みの許可も配線で届きます。番地が計算できただけでは書きません。S: Read and write enables also arrive over wires. Calculating an address alone does not write anything. Memory changes only on a clock where the ST write is enabled. Blue markers in the memory display indicate instruction locations; orange markers indicate data accesses.
単一サイクル実装の2ポートメモリ: Two-port memory in the single-cycle implementation
単一サイクルでは、LD の命令を読むことと、その命令が指定するデータを読むことが: A single-cycle LD needs both its instruction and the data it references within the same clock interval. This implementation therefore has two ports, one for instructions and one for data. It does not contain two copies of memory.
ポートを増やすには回路が必要です。段階5では時間を分けて1ポートを共用し、段階6: Extra ports require extra circuitry. Stage 5 shares one port over time; stage 6 overlaps instructions and encounters contention again; stage 7 places separate caches in front of memory. This is the starting point for changing the implementation while preserving the ISA's promise of one shared memory.
ベースレジスタと符号拡張した6 bit即値を加え、16 bitの有効番地を作りま: Adds the base register and a sign-extended 6-bit immediate to form a 16-bit effective address.
命令用とデータ用の入口を持つ共通の RAM。ST の許可でクロック時に書き込みま: Shared RAM with instruction and data ports. Writes on the clock when ST is enabled.
ALU の結果か、メモリの読み出し値かを選んで RF へ戻します。: Selects either the ALU result or the memory read value and returns it to RF.
符号付きバブルソートは、配列の隣り合う値を LD で比較し、順序が逆なら ST: Signed bubble sort uses LD to compare adjacent array elements and ST to swap them if they are out of order. JLT/JGE handle comparisons involving negative numbers.
リンクレジスタによる関数呼び出しと、スタックによる値の保存を学びます。: Learn function calls through a link register and saving values on a stack.
PC+1 をリンクレジスタへ残す JAL、レジスタの番地へ飛ぶ JALR、ソフト: Introduces JAL, which saves PC+1 in a link register; JALR, which jumps to a register-based address; and a software stack.
JAL は PC 相対の行き先へ飛ぶと同時に、次の命令の番地 PC+1 を r7: JAL jumps to a PC-relative target while saving the next instruction's address, PC+1, in r7 (LR). RET is an alias for JALR r0, r7, 0 and puts LR back into PC. Because writes to JALR's destination r0 are discarded, returning does not save another link.
JALR rd, rs1, imm は行き先を rs1+imm で求めます。CA: JALR rd, rs1, imm calculates its target as rs1+imm. CALLR r2 is an alias for JALR r7, r2, 0. A target can therefore be stored as data in memory or a register, enabling function pointers.
関数の中から別の関数を JAL で呼ぶと、r7 の前の戻り番地が上書きされます。: Calling another function with JAL overwrites the previous return address in r7. A nested computation such as factorial must save its current LR and any needed arguments in memory before calling again. Decrease SP (r6) to reserve space, save with ST, then restore with LD and increase SP after returning.
スタック専用のメモリや PUSH/POP 回路はありません。番地の小さい方へ伸ば: There is no dedicated stack memory or PUSH/POP circuit. By convention, the stack grows toward smaller addresses and SP points to the last word pushed. Ordinary instructions such as ADDI r6, -2 and ST r7, [r6+1] implement it. Remember that ADDI used to move SP also changes the flags.
呼び出し命令の回路と呼び出し規約: Call circuitry and the calling convention
書き戻しの候補に PC+1、次の PC の候補にレジスタから作った番地を加えます: PC+1 becomes another writeback source, and a register-based address becomes another next-PC source. The decoder fixes JAL's destination at r7; JALR uses the instruction's rd field. The call itself does not read or write memory.
呼び出し規約では r1〜r3 は引数や作業用、r1 は戻り値、r4/r5 は呼ば: The calling convention uses r1–r3 for arguments and temporary values, r1 for a return value, and r4/r5 for values the callee must preserve. The circuit does not enforce these rules; they let independently written functions cooperate.
演算結果の代わりに戻り番地を RF へ保存します。: Stores a return address in RF instead of an arithmetic result.
メモリ番地と同じ加算器で間接ジャンプの行き先も求めます。: Uses the memory-address adder to calculate an indirect jump target as well.
SP と LR は汎用レジスタ。保存・復元はプログラムに従います。: SP and LR are general-purpose registers. The program performs all saving and restoring.
再帰による階乗では、SP の減少と増加、LR の退避と復元を対にして追います。機: In recursive factorial, pair each decrease in SP with its increase, and each saved LR with its restoration. The feature experiment uses a leaf function, so it can return without a stack.
メモリマップド I/O と、タイマ割り込みの受け付け・復帰を学びます。: Learn memory-mapped I/O and how timer interrupts are accepted and returned from.
メモリマップド I/O、タイマ、割り込み、EPC/CAUSE/ESTAT とトラ: Adds memory-mapped I/O, a timer, interrupts, EPC/CAUSE/ESTAT, and trap handling.
LD/ST の番地が 0xFFF0 なら LED、0xFFF1 ならスイッチ、0: An LD/ST address of 0xFFF0 selects LEDs; 0xFFF1 selects switches; 0xFFF2 selects the timer period; and 0xFFF3 selects its pending status. ADDR DECODE generates RAM and device selects, and the read MUX returns the selected device's value. Programs use the same instructions as for memory.
タイマは4クロックで1カウントし、指定の周期に達すると要求を保持します。周期を書: The timer counts once every four clocks and latches a request when it reaches the configured period. Writing the period resets the count to zero; a period of zero stops it. Writing the pending-status register clears the request. Follow the wires to distinguish reading device state from changing it.
割り込み時の状態保存と復帰: Saving state on an interrupt and returning
要求があり、STATUS の IE が1なら、命令の境界で割り込みを受け付けます: When a request is pending and IE in STATUS is 1, the CPU accepts the interrupt at an instruction boundary. It saves the address of the instruction not yet executed in EPC, cause 1 in CAUSE, and the previous enable state and flags in ESTAT. It then clears IE and directs PC to the shared entry at 0x0001.
入口の処理をハンドラと呼びます。要求を消し、必要な処理を行って RETI すると: The code at that entry is the handler. It clears the request, performs the required work, then executes RETI to restore the location and state from EPC and ESTAT. General-purpose registers are not saved automatically; the handler must save and restore any values it uses.
TRAP は原因を判定し、CSR は復帰に必要な状態を保持します。GATE はそ: TRAP determines the cause, and CSR holds the state needed to return. GATE blocks register, memory, and flag writes by the instruction that would otherwise execute on that clock. Address calculations still run, leaving the inputs available for inspection.
同じトラップの仕組みを、段階8では保護違反やシステムコールにも使います。単一サイ: Stage 8 reuses this trap mechanism for protection violations and system calls. In this single-cycle stage, only one instruction needs to be interrupted, making the behavior easier to trace.
番地から装置を選びます。I/O のスイッチは直接操作できます。: Selects a device from its address. The I/O switches can be operated directly.
クロックを数えて要求を保持。CPU の許可とは独立に要求が立ちます。: Counts clocks and latches a request. Requests arise independently of the CPU's interrupt enable.
要求と許可から中断を決め、実行を取り消す命令の書き込みを遮断します。: Uses the request and enable to decide when to interrupt, and blocks writes by the canceled instruction.
EPC・CAUSE・ESTAT を保存し、RETI 時に元の状態を復元します。: Saves EPC, CAUSE, and ESTAT, then restores the previous state on RETI.
タイマ割り込みのサンプルでは、本体とハンドラを行き来します。機能を確認する実験で: The timer-interrupt sample alternates between the main program and its handler. The feature experiment starts with a request already pending, so you can observe acceptance and return without waiting for a timer period.
1命令を複数クロックで実行し、ALU とメモリを共用する実装を学びます。: Learn an implementation that executes each instruction over multiple clocks and shares its ALU and memory.
命令の意味は段階4と同じ。状態機械・途中結果レジスタ・1ポートメモリ・ready: Instruction meanings remain the same as stage 4. The implementation changes to a state machine, intermediate registers, one-port memory, and waits for ready.
命令の処理段階と状態機械: Instruction phases and the state machine
単一サイクルでは、命令の取得から結果の保存までが1クロックでした。マルチサイクル: In a single-cycle implementation, instruction fetch through result storage took one clock. A multicycle implementation splits this work into FETCH, DECODE, EXEC, MEM, and MEMWB (or ALUWB for arithmetic). Several clocks complete one instruction, each storing the values needed by the next phase.
STATE が現在の仕事を覚え、CONTROL が命令と状態から各 MUX と書: STATE remembers the current phase, while CONTROL uses the instruction and state to select MUX inputs and write enables. Compare the different results of One instruction and One clock.
ALU・メモリの共用と途中結果の保持: Sharing ALU and memory; retaining intermediate results
命令を読む FETCH とデータを読む MEM は別のクロックなので、同じ1ポー: Instruction fetch in FETCH and data access in MEM occur on different clocks, so both can use the same single memory port. The ALU is also reused for PC+1, arithmetic, and effective-address calculation. Switching input MUXes gives the same adder different jobs.
途中で入力が変わっても結果を失わないよう、IR に命令、A/B に読み出したレジ: IR holds the instruction, A/B hold register values, ALUOUT holds the arithmetic result, and MDR holds memory data so later input changes do not destroy intermediate results. Reducing circuitry requires this temporary storage and sequencing control.
要求を出してもメモリがまだ値を返せなければ ready = L のままです。CO: If memory cannot return a value yet, ready remains L after a request. CONTROL holds the current state and advances on the clock when ready becomes H. Progress depends on an arriving response, rather than a fixed instruction animation.
短い経路を複数回通るので、1クロックの仕事量は減りますが、命令あたりクロック数: Traversing shorter paths several times reduces the work per clock but increases clocks per instruction (CPI). That does not necessarily make execution faster. The comparison display includes logic depth as well as clock count. Treat t separately from performance: it is observation time that depends on layout.
現在の段階と ready に応じて、次の段階と各書き込み許可を決めます。: Uses the current phase and ready to choose the next phase and all write enables.
取り込んだ命令を、処理が終わるまで保持します。: Holds the fetched instruction until processing finishes.
入力の選択を切り替え、PC の更新と命令の演算・番地計算を担います。: Switches input sources to update PC and perform arithmetic and address calculations.
メモリ応答を保存して、後の WB でレジスタへ渡します。: Saves the memory response and passes it to a register during a later WB phase.
段階3と同じ階乗を実行し、結果が変わらないことを確認します。実装の比較では、多い: Run the same factorial program as stage 3 and confirm the result is unchanged. Compare the larger clock count together with the shorter logic path.
3段パイプラインで命令を並行して処理し、データ依存と資源の競合を確認します。: Overlap instructions in a three-stage pipeline and examine data dependencies and resource contention.
IF・DX・MW の3段と段間レジスタ、依存検出、フォワーディングを導入します。: Introduces IF, DX, and MW stages, pipeline registers, dependency detection, and forwarding.
3段パイプラインと段間レジスタ: The three-stage pipeline and its registers
IF は命令の取り込み、DX は解読と演算、MW はメモリアクセスと書き戻しです: IF fetches instructions, DX decodes and executes, and MW accesses memory and writes back. Saving instruction values and control signals between stages lets each stage process a different instruction. Each instruction still takes time to traverse the pipeline, but the aim is to complete one instruction per clock in steady state.
パイプライン図の同じ番地が次の段へ移る様子を追います。回路図は上段を左から右に進: Follow the same instruction address as it moves between stages in the pipeline chart. The circuit runs left to right across the upper row, then back along the lower row. Destination register numbers and valid bits travel between stages along with data.
次の命令が前の命令の結果を使うとき、RF から読む値は古い可能性があります。HA: When an instruction needs its predecessor's result, the value read from RF may be stale. HAZARD detects the dependency and waits, or FORWARD sends the MW result directly to a DX input. A stall holds pipeline registers and inserts an invalid empty slot (a bubble) where needed.
3段版は MW でメモリを読み、その値を同じクロックの DX の ALU へ渡せ: The three-stage version can read memory in MW and pass that value to the DX ALU in the same clock interval. This can avoid a data-dependency stall immediately after a load, but creates a long combinational path: memory → forwarding MUX → ALU. Stage 6b splits that path.
1ポートメモリでは MW のデータアクセスと IF の命令取り込みが競合します。: With one memory port, a data access in MW conflicts with instruction fetch in IF. This is a structural hazard. It can cause a wait even without register dependencies; try two ports to isolate its effect.
この段階は I/O を持ちますが、割り込みと保護はまだ統合していません。ISA: This stage includes I/O but does not yet integrate interrupts or protection. Instruction encoding and arithmetic keep their meanings, but available features follow the mmio profile. Stage 9 adds traps to the combined implementation.
取り込んだ命令と PC を保持し、次の命令と区別します。: Holds the fetched instruction and its PC, keeping it distinct from the next instruction.
読みたいレジスタと未完了の保存先を比べ、待つ必要を検出します。: Compares source registers with pending destinations to detect when waiting is necessary.
MW の新しい値を DX に直接渡す入力を選びます。: Selects inputs that pass new values directly from MW to DX.
保持・空きを入れる・取り消すという段間制御をまとめます。: Coordinates holding, inserting bubbles, and canceling instructions between stages.
ハザードの見本を使ってストールだけの場合とフォワーディングを比較します。同じ最終: Use the hazard sample to compare stalling alone with forwarding. Check that forwarding reduces waits while preserving the same final state.
5段パイプラインのストール、フォワーディング、フラッシュ、分岐予測を比較します。: Compare stalls, forwarding, flushes, and branch prediction in a five-stage pipeline.
IF・ID・EX・MEM・WB の5段へ分割し、ロード待ち・フラッシュ・分岐予測: Splits execution into IF, ID, EX, MEM, and WB, and compares load waits, flushes, and branch prediction.
5段への分割とロード直後の依存: Five stages and dependencies immediately after a load
3段版の DX を ID（解読・読み出し）と EX（演算）に、MW を MEM（: DX from the three-stage version becomes ID (decode and register read) and EX (execute); MW becomes MEM (memory) and WB (writeback). More pipeline registers shorten each clock's combinational path. The next instruction uses a stage once its predecessor has moved on.
EX の算術結果は EX/MEM から次の EX へ転送できます。しかし LD: An arithmetic result from EX can be forwarded from EX/MEM to the next EX. An LD result, however, is unavailable until the end of MEM, too late for the immediately following instruction. HAZARD inserts a one-clock wait so the result can be forwarded from MEM/WB.
設定0は必要な値と分岐の確定を待ち、設定1はデータを転送して待ちを減らします。設: Mode 0 waits for operands and branch resolution; mode 1 forwards data to reduce waits. Mode 2 fetches following instructions without waiting for a branch, then flushes them if EX resolves a different target. Mode 3 predicts using a BTB containing previous targets and 2-bit history.
予測値は正しさの根拠にはしません。BRANCH は実際の次の PC と予測した: Predictions are never trusted for correctness. BRANCH compares the actual next PC with the predicted PC and corrects mismatches. Canceled instructions lose their valid bits so they cannot leave register or memory results behind. Incorrectly predicting a non-branch instruction as a branch is corrected too.
結果待ちはデータハザード、次の命令の番地が未確定なのは制御ハザード、MEM と: Waiting for a result is a data hazard; an unresolved next-instruction address is a control hazard; MEM and IF competing for one port is a structural hazard. Their causes differ, so forwarding alone cannot eliminate all waits.
CPI はクロック数÷完了命令数です。短い実験では、パイプラインを満たす時間や最: CPI is clock count divided by completed instructions. In short experiments, filling and draining the pipeline account for a large fraction of execution. Also compare performance with a longer, complete sample, and consider logic depth per clock alongside CPI.
値、レジスタ番号、制御信号、PC、有効ビットを同じ命令の組として保持します。: Keep data, register numbers, control signals, PC, and valid bits together as one instruction's state.
転送できる結果と、ロードのようにまだ待つ必要のある結果を区別します。: Distinguishes results that can be forwarded from results, such as loads, that still require a wait.
実際の次の番地と予測を比較し、行き先の修正を要求します。: Compares the actual next address with the prediction and requests a correction.
過去の行き先と分岐の履歴で次の取り込みを予測します。外れは必ず修正します。: Predicts the next fetch from past targets and branch history. Mispredictions are always corrected.
ハザードの見本では、4つの設定と1/2ポートを比較できます。短いロード依存と分岐: The hazard sample compares four modes and one or two ports. Use the short load-dependency and branch experiments to separate the causes, then return to CPI for the complete sample.
命令・データキャッシュのヒットとミス、主記憶へのアクセスを学びます。: Learn instruction and data cache hits and misses, and accesses to main memory.
分離した I/D キャッシュ、タグ比較、ミス処理、バス調停、遅い主記憶、FENC: Adds separate I/D caches, tag comparison, miss handling, bus arbitration, slow main memory, and FENCEI.
命令とデータの手前に、それぞれ4行×2語のキャッシュを置きます。ヒットすれば I: Instruction and data accesses each get a cache with four lines of two words. On hits, IF and MEM can use separate caches simultaneously. Main memory remains shared and is accessed only when needed. Separate I/D caches do not turn the ISA's memory into two memories.
番地をタグ・行番号・行内の位置に分けます。下位1 bit が2語のどちらか、次の: An address is split into a tag, line index, and word offset. The low bit selects one of two words; the next two bits select one of four lines; the remaining bits are the tag. A line is usable only when it is valid and its tag matches. Similar addresses with different tags refer to different data.
キャッシュミス時の補充と待ち: Refilling and waiting on a cache miss
ミスした制御器はバスへ補充を要求します。BUS ARBITER は I 側と D: A controller that misses requests a refill over the bus. BUS ARBITER sends I-side and D-side requests to main memory one at a time and returns each response to its requester. By default, a main-memory transfer takes four clocks. The waiting pipeline retains the values it needs.
一度使った語をまた使う時間的局所性と、隣の語を使う空間的局所性が効果の源です。機: Caches benefit from temporal locality (using a word again) and spatial locality (using nearby words). The feature experiment shows a first read also fetching its neighbor. Caches do not accelerate everything: line conflicts and refill waits remain.
この実装はライトスルーで、ST は主記憶にも反映します。ストアバッファやライトバ: This implementation is write-through, so ST also updates main memory. There is no store buffer or write-back policy. I/O addresses bypass the caches and go to devices, avoiding reads from stale copies of device state.
命令もメモリに置いたデータなので ST で書き換えられますが、I-CACHE は: Instructions are data in memory and can be changed with ST, but I-CACHE does not observe that write. FENCEI invalidates the instruction cache and refetches following instructions, making earlier writes visible. The code-modification sample demonstrates the problem of an old copy at the same address.
番地を分割し、保存したタグと valid を比較してヒットを判断します。: Splits the address and compares the stored tag and valid bit to determine a hit.
命令とデータの小さなコピーを別々に保持します。: Hold separate small copies of instructions and data.
ヒット時の応答、ミス時の補充要求、待ちと再開を制御します。: Control hit responses, refill requests on misses, waiting, and resumption.
2つの要求元が1つの遅い主記憶を順番に使えるようにします。: Lets two requesters take turns using one slow main memory.
キャッシュと局所性のサンプルは繰り返しアクセスを観察するものです。主記憶の待ちを: The cache-locality sample demonstrates repeated accesses. Change main-memory latency to compare the benefit of hits with the cost of misses.
権限モード、TLB による番地変換、メモリ保護を学びます。: Learn privilege modes, address translation through a TLB, and memory protection.
ユーザー/カーネルモード、I/D TLB、書き込み・実行権限、保護例外とシステム: Adds user/kernel modes, I/D TLBs, write and execute permissions, protection exceptions, and system calls. This stage returns to single-cycle execution for easier observation.
TLB による仮想番地から物理番地への変換: Translating virtual addresses to physical addresses
ユーザープログラムが使う番地を仮想番地、RAM に渡す番地を物理番地と呼びます。: Addresses used by user programs are virtual addresses; addresses sent to RAM are physical addresses. A page contains 32 words. The TLB translates the upper 11-bit page number while preserving the lower 5-bit offset. The same virtual address can be mapped to a different physical page.
I-TLB は命令、D-TLB はデータ用で各4エントリです。すべての有効なエン: I-TLB serves instructions and D-TLB serves data, with four entries each. All valid entries are compared in parallel. Kernel mode bypasses translation so the OS can access physical memory. A cache holds copies of data; a TLB holds address mappings. Their roles differ.
TLB のエントリには W（書き込み可）と X（実行可）があります。ST は W: Each TLB entry has W (writable) and X (executable) bits. ST requires W; instruction fetch requires X. An OS can make code executable but not writable, and data writable but not executable, preventing data from being executed as instructions. The OS establishes this W^X policy.
対応がないと TLB ミス、権限が足りないと保護違反の例外になります。ハードウェ: A missing mapping causes a TLB miss; insufficient permissions cause a protection exception. Hardware does not walk a page table. The OS inspects CAUSE and BADVA, fills an entry with TLBW if appropriate, and executes RETI. EPC points to the faulting instruction so it can be retried after repair.
ユーザーモードで制御レジスタを書き換えたり、割り込みを禁止したりすることはできま: User mode cannot change control registers or disable interrupts. SYSCALL deliberately traps to ask the OS to perform work. Because SYSCALL completes a request, its EPC points to the next instruction; a memory exception that needs repair and retry points to the faulting instruction itself.
ミニ OS は RAM に2つのプログラムをコピーし、TLB を設定し、ユーザー: The mini OS copies two programs into RAM, configures the TLBs, and runs them in user mode. It switches contexts on timer interrupts and handles system calls and TLB misses. It stops a program that jumps to a non-executable page. This is a small educational OS, not a model of every feature in a production OS.
命令の仮想番地を変換し、実行権限 X を確認します。: Translates the instruction's virtual address and checks execute permission X.
データ番地を変換し、ST のとき書き込み権限 W を確認します。: Translates the data address and checks write permission W for ST.
ミスや違反の原因と番地を保存させ、違反命令の書き込みを取り消します。: Records the cause and address of a miss or violation, and cancels the faulting instruction's writes.
権限モード、例外の戻り先、原因、問題の仮想番地を保持します。: Hold privilege mode, exception return address, cause, and the offending virtual address.
ミニ OS は初期化からプロセスの切り替えまで一貫して動きます。機能を確認する実: The mini OS runs continuously from initialization through process switching. The feature experiment begins in user mode with TLBs already configured, isolating a successful LD and a rejected ST.
パイプライン、キャッシュ、TLB、割り込み・例外を統合した動作を確認します。: Observe a combined pipeline, caches, TLBs, interrupts, and exceptions.

MEM combines it with data-side exceptions, allows only older instructions to complete, and cancels the effects of the faulting instruction and younger ones. This clearly defined boundary of completed work is a precise exception.
GATE は違反した ST を止め、MEM REDIRECT は PC をトラッ: GATE blocks a faulting ST; MEM REDIRECT sends PC to the trap entry and flushes younger instructions. r0〜r7 は、CPU 内部で値を保持する8本のレジスタの名前です。命令には中身: r0–r7 name eight registers that hold values inside the CPU. An instruction encodes a register’s number in three bits, not its contents (r3 means number 3, encoded as 011).
各欄を左からつなぐと、CPU が読む16 bit の命令になります。: Joining these fields from left to right produces the 16-bit instruction the CPU reads.
ADD r3, r1, r2 は「r1 と r2 の中身を足し、r3 に保存する: ADD r3, r1, r2 adds the contents of r1 and r2 and stores the result in r3. rd names the destination field; rs1 and rs2 name the two source fields.
ADDI r1, -1 は「r1 の中身に −1 を足し、r1 に戻す」という命: ADDI r1, -1 adds −1 to the contents of r1 and writes the result back to r1. The rd field selects both the source and destination.
imm は命令に直接埋め込む数（即値）です。ここでは −1 を9 bit の 1: imm is a number embedded directly in the instruction (an immediate). Here −1 is encoded as the nine bits 111111111 and sign-extended to 16-bit 0xFFFF for calculation.
LD r2, [r1+3] は「r1 の中身に3を足した番地から、1語を読み出し: LD r2, [r1+3] reads one word from the address given by the contents of r1 plus 3, then stores it in r2. Square brackets refer to memory contents.
rd に保存先 r2 の番号2、rs1 に番地の元 r1 の番号1、imm6 に: rd encodes destination r2 as number 2; rs1 encodes address base r1 as number 1; imm6 encodes offset 3. If r1 = 0x0080 and memory three words ahead holds 42, r2 receives 42.
JNZ 4 は「Z フラグが0なら番地4へ飛ぶ」という命令です。レジスタの指定は: JNZ 4 jumps to address 4 if the Z flag is zero. It specifies no registers: cond encodes the condition, and off8 encodes the relative offset to the target.
この命令は番地0にあるため、次の命令は番地1。行き先4との差は 4 − 1 =: This instruction is at address 0, so the next instruction is at address 1. The target offset is 4 − 1 = 3. The instruction encodes this offset as 00000011, not the target address 4. If Z = 1, execution continues at address 1.
op = 0001 で ALU 演算を、funct = 000 で加算を選びます: op = 0001 selects ALU operations; funct = 000 selects addition.

a は加算の元になる {0} bit の値です。PC+1 の回路では、現在の命令: a is the {0}-bit value to increment. In a PC+1 circuit, it receives the current instruction address.
a に固定値 {1} を加え、下位 {0} bit だけを残します。上限を超える: Add the constant {1} to a and retain the low {0} bits, wrapping around on overflow. Recompute when the input arrives, without waiting for a clock.
y は加算後の値です。次の番地候補などを接続先へ渡します。この加算器自体は PC: y is the incremented value, passed onward as a candidate next address or other result. This adder itself neither stores nor updates PC.
a と b は足し合わせる2つの {0} bit の値です。分岐先の計算では、基: a and b are the two {0}-bit operands. For a branch target, they may carry a base address and an offset extracted from the instruction.
a + b を計算し、下位 {0} bit を残します。符号拡張済みの負のオフセ: Compute a + b and retain the low {0} bits. The same addition handles a sign-extended negative offset. Recompute on input arrivals without storing the result.
y は和です。番地の選択回路やレジスタの入力へ渡されます。このモジュールには桁上: y is the sum, sent to an address selector or register input. This module has no separate carry or flags output.
a・b は16 bitの演算対象、op は演算の種類です。op は 0 ADD、: a and b are 16-bit operands; op selects the operation: 0 ADD, 1 SUB, 2 AND, 3 OR, 4 XOR, 5 SHL, 6 SHR, 7 SRA, or 8 PASS.
op に応じて加減算・ビット演算・シフトを行い、PASS では b を通します。: Perform the selected arithmetic, bitwise operation, or shift; PASS forwards b. Shift counts use the low four bits of b. Recompute the result and flags on input arrivals; the ALU does not store them.
ra・rb は読むレジスタの番号（0〜7）、wa は書き込み先の番号です。wd: ra and rb select registers to read (0–7); wa selects the register to write. wd carries the 16-bit write data, and we enables writing.
8本のレジスタを保持し、2つの読み出し口で別々のレジスタを同時に読みます。we: Store eight registers and read two independently through separate ports. On a rising edge with we = H, store wd in register wa. r0 always reads as zero and ignores writes.
da は ra の読み出し値、db は rb の読み出し値です。読み出しはクロッ: da reads register ra; db reads register rb. Reads do not wait for a clock. A change to a register index or stored source value updates the corresponding output.
iaddr は読み出す命令の語番地です。このメモリは命令とデータを同じ512語: iaddr is the instruction word address. Instructions and data share a 512-word × 16-bit memory. Addresses count words, not bytes.
指定された番地の保存内容を読み出します。読み出しは組み合わせ処理なので、番地が到: Read the contents stored at the specified address. Reads are combinational and reevaluate when an address arrives. The program is placed in memory at reset.
idata は iaddr にある16 bitの命令語です。命令の意味を解釈する: idata is the 16-bit instruction word at iaddr. The downstream decoder interprets its meaning.
daddr はデータの番地、wd は書き込む値、we は書き込み許可です。: daddr is the data address, wd is the write value, and we is the write enable.
we = H の立ち上がりで、RAM範囲の daddr に wd を保存します。: On a rising edge with we = H, store wd at daddr if it is in RAM. Read and write timing differ.
rd は daddr にあるデータです。: rd is the data stored at daddr.
dreq はデータ側がメモリを使う要求です。: dreq requests use of memory by the data port.
1ポート設定ではデータ側を優先し、命令側を待たせます。2ポート設定では両方を同時: With one port, prioritize data access and stall instruction fetch. With two ports, both reads can proceed together.
命令側が待つ間は iwait = H、idata = 0 となります。: While instruction fetch is blocked, iwait = H and idata = 0.
ir はメモリから届いた16 bitの命令語です。レジスタ番号や即値は、この命令: ir is the 16-bit instruction word from memory. Register indices and immediates are encoded as bit fields within it.
命令形式を見てビットを切り分け、必要な即値を16 bitへ拡張します。符号付きの: Select the instruction format, extract its fields, and expand the immediate to 16 bits. Signed immediates are sign-extended; LUI places its immediate in the upper bits. No ALU operation or register write occurs here.
ra・rb は読み出し番号、rd は書き込み先番号、imm は展開済みの即値です: ra and rb are read indices, rd is the destination index, and imm is the expanded immediate. The mapping depends on the instruction: ST selects its stored register through rb, and JAL selects link register r7 through rd.
ir は解読する16 bitの命令語です。データの値そのものではなく、何を実行す: ir is the 16-bit instruction to decode. It specifies what to do, rather than supplying the operand data itself.
オペコードと命令形式から、演算の種類・データ経路の選択・書き込み許可を決めます。: Decode the opcode and format into an ALU operation, data-path selections, and write enables. This module only decodes; connected modules compute and store the results.
各出力は各部への指示です。1 bitの許可信号は H のとき有効、複数 bitの: Each output instructs another part of the CPU. A one-bit enable is active at H; a multi-bit selector encodes a choice. The outputs present in this configuration and their roles are listed below.
halted = H なら、すべての制御出力を0にします。: When halted = H, force all control outputs to zero.
kernel はカーネルモードかどうかを表します。: kernel indicates whether the CPU is in kernel mode.
ユーザーモードでの特権命令は通常の動作を許可せず、不正命令として扱います。: A privileged instruction in user mode is treated as illegal instead of enabling its normal actions.
pcSrc は命令が要求する次PCの種類、cond は分岐条件、flags は保: pcSrc specifies the requested next-PC source, cond is the branch condition, and flags holds Z, C, N, V. This circuit does not calculate the destination address itself.
条件分岐なら cond を flags に照らして判定し、不成立なら PC+1: For a conditional branch, test cond against flags and choose PC+1 if false. Sequential execution, relative and indirect jumps, and interrupt return are converted into their corresponding source indices.
sel は次PC用MUXへの選択番号（0 PC+1、1 target、2 rs1: sel selects the next-PC MUX input (0 PC+1, 1 target, 2 rs1+imm, 3 EPC, 4 vector); en enables the PC register. Each stage connects only the sources it needs.
停止中は en = L とし、PCを保持させます。: While halted, set en = L to retain PC.
take = H は停止や通常の選択より優先し、sel = 4 と en = H: take = H overrides halt and normal selection: sel = 4 and en = H select the trap vector.
addr はアクセス先の16 bit番地、we は書き込み要求です。: addr is the 16-bit access address, and we requests a write.
番地を比較して、RAM（0x0000〜0x01FF）、LED・スイッチ（0xFF: Compare the address to select RAM (0x0000–0x01FF), LEDs/switches (0xFFF0–0xFFF1), the timer (0xFFF2–0xFFF3), or an unmapped region. This module routes control, not the data itself.
この構成にある行き先別の書き込み許可信号だけを出します。選ばれていない装置には書: Produce the destination-specific write enables present in this configuration. Unselected devices are not allowed to write.
ramReq はRAM範囲への読み書き要求です。: ramReq requests a read or write in the RAM range.
ioWe・tmWe はI/O・タイマへの書き込み許可、sel は読み出しMUXの: ioWe and tmWe enable I/O and timer writes. sel selects the read MUX: 0 RAM, 1 I/O, 2 TIMER, 3 unmapped.
addr は装置内の番地、wd は書き込みデータ、we は書き込み許可です。画面: addr selects a device register, wd is write data, and we enables writing. The on-screen switches are external inputs as well.
0xFFF0はLEDの保存値、0xFFF1はスイッチの値に対応します。we =: 0xFFF0 addresses the stored LED value; 0xFFF1 addresses the switches. On an edge with we = H and addr = 0xFFF0, store the low eight bits of wd for the LEDs. The CPU cannot overwrite the switches.
rd は選択したLEDの保存値またはスイッチの値を16 bitで返します。その他: rd returns the selected LED or switch value as 16 bits, or zero for other addresses. LEDs display the stored value; merely delivering a new wd does not change them.
addr は周期（0xFFF2）または要求状態（0xFFF3）の番地、wd は設: addr selects the period (0xFFF2) or request status (0xFFF3); wd is the setting and we enables writing. The timer counts the CPU clock.
周期が0でなければ4クロックを1カウントとし、設定周期に達すると要求を保持します: When the period is nonzero, count once per four clocks and latch a request at the configured period. Writing the period resets the count; writing the status clears the request. Updates occur on rising edges.
rd は選択した周期または要求状態、irq は割り込み要求です。irq は一瞬の: rd returns the selected period or request status. irq stays H while a request is pending, rather than pulsing briefly. Separate trap logic decides whether to accept it.
i_で始まる端子は通過候補の制御信号です。kill はその命令の効果を取り消す指: Inputs prefixed i_ are control signals that may pass through. kill requests cancellation of the instruction’s effects.
kill = H なら全出力を0にし、それ以外では入力を同名の出力へそのまま通し: When kill = H, force every output to zero; otherwise pass each input to its matching output. This blocks write enables and other controls, rather than erasing the write data.
出力は i_ を取り除いた名前の制御信号です。接続先のレジスタやメモリが、この許: Outputs have the same names with i_ removed. Connected registers and memories use these controls at the clock edge to decide whether to update.
halted = H でも全出力を0にします。: halted = H also forces all outputs to zero.
wait はメモリなどの完了待ちです。: wait indicates an outstanding memory or other operation.
wait = H の間も全出力を0にし、同じ命令の効果が繰り返し書き込まれること: While wait = H, force all outputs to zero to prevent repeatedly committing the same instruction’s effects.
irq は割り込み要求、ie は受け付け許可、halted は停止状態、pc は: irq is the interrupt request, ie enables acceptance, halted indicates halt, and pc supplies the base return address.
irq と ie がともに H なら割り込みを受け付けます。判定は入力の到着で行: Accept an interrupt when both irq and ie are H. Decide on input arrival; connected CSR and PC circuits store the return address and change PC at the clock edge.
take はトラップ受け付け、cause は原因番号、epc は保存する戻り番地: take indicates trap acceptance, cause encodes the reason, and epc is the return address to store. Normally pc is passed to epc so execution can resume there.
itlbMiss・ifault・illegal・syscall・dtlbMiss: itlbMiss, ifault, illegal, syscall, dtlbMiss, and wfault identify exceptions; dva is the data virtual address and pcInc is the next instruction address.
割り込みを優先し、その次に命令TLBミス→実行保護→不正命令→システムコール→デ: Prioritize interrupts, then instruction TLB miss, execute protection, illegal instruction, syscall, data TLB miss, and write protection. Do not accept instruction exceptions while halted.
システムコールの epc は pcInc です。badva には命令側の障害なら: For a syscall, epc is pcInc. badva receives pc for an instruction-side address fault or dva for a data-side address fault.
num は読む・書くCSRの番号、wd・we は書き込み値と許可です。take・: num selects a CSR; wd and we supply write data and permission. take, cause, epcIn, and flags supply trap information. reti, ei, and di request return, interrupt enable, and interrupt disable.
STATUS・ESTAT・EPC・CAUSEなどを保持します。立ち上がりでは t: Store STATUS, ESTAT, EPC, CAUSE, and related state. Rising-edge priority is take, reti, ei, di, then we. A trap saves the previous status and flags in ESTAT, saves the return address in EPC, and disables interrupts. Reads need no clock.
rd は num で選んだCSR（0 STATUS、1 ESTAT、2 EPC、: rd reads the selected CSR: 0 STATUS, 1 ESTAT, 2 EPC, 3 CAUSE, 4 BADVA, 5 SCRATCH. ie is interrupt enable; epc is the saved return address; eflags holds the flags saved in ESTAT.
badva はアドレス関連の例外で保存する問題の仮想番地です。: badva is the faulting virtual address saved for address-related exceptions.
トラップ時はカーネルモードへ入り、RETIで保存したモードを復元します。: Enter kernel mode on a trap and restore the saved mode on RETI.
kernel はカーネルモードで H となり、TLBや特権命令の判定へ渡ります。: kernel is H in kernel mode and feeds TLB and privilege checks.
va は変換する16 bit仮想番地、kernel はモード、req はアクセス: va is the 16-bit virtual address, kernel selects the mode, and req indicates an access. we, wa, and wb request a TLB-entry write and supply its encoded settings.
32語を1ページとし、va の上位11 bitを4つの有効エントリと比較します。: Use 32-word pages and compare the upper 11 bits of va against four valid entries. On a match, substitute the physical page number and preserve the low five bits. Kernel mode bypasses translation. On a rising edge with we = H targeting this TLB, store the entry encoded by wa and wb.
pa は変換結果、miss は要求時に一致するエントリがないこと、fault は: pa is the translated address; miss means an access has no matching entry; fault indicates a permission violation. User-mode faults go to trap logic. On a miss pa remains equal to va, so it must be interpreted together with miss.
write はデータを書き込むアクセスかどうかを表します。: write indicates a data write access.
データTLBでは write = H のとき、エントリの書き込み許可 W を検査: For the data TLB, check the entry’s W permission when write = H.
exc は命令TLBミスまたは実行保護違反の原因番号です。パイプラインでは命令と: exc encodes an instruction TLB miss or execute-protection fault and travels with the instruction through the pipeline.
addr は命令またはデータの語番地、req はアクセス要求、we は書き込み指: addr is an instruction or data word address; req requests access, we selects a write, and wd supplies 16-bit write data. Instructions and data share one port.
ready は要求を完了できる合図、rd は読み出した16 bitです。待ってい: ready signals that the request can complete; rd is the 16-bit read value. rd is zero while waiting, so control logic checks ready before capturing it.
state は状態レジスタの値、ir は命令、flags は分岐用フラグです。r: state is the state-register value, ir is the instruction, and flags supplies branch flags. ready is the memory response, irq requests an accepted interrupt, and halted indicates halt.
FETCH→DECODE→EXECを基本に、演算ならALUWB、読み書きならME: Control a sequence beginning with FETCH, DECODE, EXEC, followed as needed by ALUWB or MEM/MEMWB. Remain in a wait state while ready is L. This module is combinational next-state logic; the separate STATE register stores the state.
next は次の状態番号です。残りの出力はMUXの選択、メモリ要求、PC・IR・: next is the next state index. Other outputs select MUXes, request memory, and enable writes to PC, IR, MDR, ALUOUT, the register file, and other state, activating only the work needed in this phase.
d_で始まる各端子は前段の結果です。命令の有効性 v、番地、データ、制御信号など: Inputs prefixed d_ carry the preceding stage’s results: instruction validity v, addresses, data, and control signals as one group. en enables capture; clr requests clearing.
立ち上がりで clr = H なら全項目を0にし、そうでなければ en = H: At a rising edge, clr = H clears all fields; otherwise en = H captures every field together. If both are L, retain the fields. clr takes priority and creates a bubble with v = L.
d_を取り除いた同名の端子に、保持した各項目を出します。データと制御信号を同じ命: Outputs with d_ removed expose the stored fields. Keeping data and controls together ensures that the next stage does not operate on one instruction’s data using another instruction’s controls.
bus は複数の制御信号を詰めたビット列です。各信号の位置と幅は、このモジュール: bus packs multiple control signals into one bit vector. Their positions and widths are fixed by this module’s configuration.
bus を決められたビット範囲に分けます。命令の再解読や計算、保存は行わず、束に: Split bus into its defined bit ranges. This distributes bundled wires into individual signals without decoding the instruction again, computing, or storing anything.
各出力は取り出した制御信号です。下に示す出力名とビット幅が、この段で使える信号に: Each output is one extracted control signal. The output names and widths below identify the signals available in this stage.
ir は命令語、v は有効な命令かどうかです。v = L は命令が入っていない「: ir is the instruction word; v indicates a valid instruction. v = L denotes a bubble with no instruction.
命令を解読して、実行段・メモリ段・書き戻し段で必要な制御をそれぞれまとめます。v: Decode the instruction and group controls for execution, memory, and writeback. When v = L, zero the controls so a bubble cannot write registers or memory.
ex・m・wb は各段へ運ぶ制御信号の束です。useA・useB はどの読み出し: ex, m, and wb carry the per-stage control bundles. useA and useB indicate which read operands are used; ctl identifies control/serializing instructions. These feed hazard detection.
kernel は特権判定用のモード、iexc は命令の取り込み時に見つかった例外: kernel supplies the privilege mode; iexc carries an exception found during instruction fetch.
取り込み時の例外や不正・特権命令を検出すると、その命令の通常の制御を止め、例外を: A fetch exception or illegal/privileged instruction suppresses normal controls and sends an exception onward.
exc は例外の原因番号で、命令とともにMEM段のトラップ判定まで運ばれます。: exc is the exception cause code, carried with the instruction to MEM-stage trap handling.
回路からの入力端子はありません。画面で選んだハザード処理の設定が入力元です。: There are no circuit input terminals. The hazard-handling setting selected in the UI is the source.
選ばれた設定を2 bitの番号にします。0はストールのみ、1はフォワーディング、: Encode the setting in two bits: 0 stalls only; 1 forwarding; 2 forwarding and flushing; 3 also enables branch prediction.
mode をハザード検出・フォワーディング・分岐予測へ渡し、同じ回路で処理方式を: mode feeds hazard detection, forwarding, and branch prediction so the same circuit can demonstrate different strategies.
ra・rb と useA・useB は後続命令が読むレジスタ、deRd・deWb: ra/rb and useA/useB identify the younger instruction’s read registers. deRd, deWb, and deM describe an older instruction’s destination and controls. ctl identifies a control instruction; mode selects the strategy.
読みたいレジスタと、まだ結果が使えない先行命令の書き込み先を比較します。ストール: Compare needed registers with destinations whose results are not yet available. Stall-only mode waits for writeback; forwarding permits progress when a result can be supplied directly. Still stall dependencies that forwarding cannot satisfy, such as an immediate load-use dependency in five stages.
stall = H はデータ依存による停止要求、hold = H は分岐などの行: stall = H requests a data-dependency stall. hold = H requests waiting for a control instruction’s outcome. NPC generates the actual enables and clears that stop registers.
emRd・emWb は、さらに先の段にある命令の書き込み先と制御です。: emRd and emWb describe the destination and controls of an instruction one stage farther ahead.
ra・rb は実行する命令の読み出し番号、mwRd・mwWe は書き戻す先行命令: ra and rb are the executing instruction’s source indices. mwRd and mwWe identify an older writeback destination and enable. mode controls forwarding. Operand data itself does not enter this module.
同じレジスタへ書く先行命令があれば、その結果を直接受け取る経路を選びます。mod: If an older instruction writes the needed register, select its result directly. mode = 0 selects the normal register value. External MUXes route the data; this circuit only decides their selectors.
selA・selB が2つの入力経路の選択です。0はレジスタ値、2は書き戻し側の: selA and selB select the two operand paths: 0 is the register value; 2 is the writeback result.
emRd・emWb はEX/MEM側の書き込み先と制御です。: emRd and emWb identify the EX/MEM destination and controls.
EX/MEM側で結果が既に得られる演算を優先し、ロードなど未完成の結果は選びませ: Prefer an already available EX/MEM result; do not select an unfinished result such as a load.
br・jal・jalr は分岐の種類、cond・flags は分岐条件とフラグで: br, jal, and jalr identify the branch type; cond and flags specify its condition. pc1 is the sequential address, target and jtarget are candidate destinations, and pn is the predicted address used at fetch.
条件を判定し、成立なら分岐先、不成立なら pc1 を実際の次PCにします。JAL: Resolve the condition and choose the branch target if taken, otherwise pc1. JAL and JALR are unconditional. Compare the actual next PC with pn and request redirection if they differ.
npc は正しい次PC、redirect は予測の修正要求、taken は分岐成: npc is the correct next PC; redirect requests correction; taken indicates a taken branch; isBr identifies a branch instruction. Branch outcomes and addresses also train the predictor.
pc は取り込み中の番地、pc1 はその次の番地、mode は予測方式です。up: pc is the fetch address, pc1 is its successor, and mode selects prediction. upd, upc1, taken, and target carry training information from a resolved branch.
pc の下位2 bitで4項目の表を引き、タグ一致と2 bitカウンタで成立を予: Index four entries using the low two bits of pc, check the tag, and use a two-bit counter. In mode 3, a matching counter of at least 2 selects the saved target. On an enabled update edge, increment for taken and decrement for not taken, saturating at 0–3.
pn は予測した次PC、pt は成立と予測したとき H です。予測を使わない、表: pn is the predicted next PC; pt is H for a taken prediction. Without prediction, a matching entry, or a taken prediction, pn = pc1.
hold = H の間は学習用の情報があっても表を更新しません。: Do not update the table while hold = H, even if training information is present.
exRedir・memRedir は行き先の修正、stall はデータ依存、ho: exRedir and memRedir request redirection; stall indicates a data dependency, hold a control wait, and halted a halt. Configurations with memory waits also receive fwait and mwait.
待ちや修正の理由を調停し、PCと各パイプラインレジスタを進める・保持する・消すか: Arbitrate waits and redirects to advance, retain, or clear PC and pipeline registers. Prioritize a global memory wait. On redirection, discard younger instructions. A stall holds the required stages while allowing eligible older instructions to advance.
sel はPC用MUXの選択（0 予測、1 実行段の修正、2 メモリ段の修正）。: sel selects the PC MUX: 0 prediction, 1 execution-stage correction, 2 memory-stage correction. pcEn and per-stage En enable updates; Clr requests a bubble at the next rising edge.
HALT・FENCEIなど、後続の取り込み直しが必要な命令を見つけます。通常の命: Identify instructions such as HALT and FENCEI that require younger instructions to be refetched. Ordinary instructions need no correction; state-changing instructions request refetch from pc1.
redirect は行き先修正の要求、target は修正先の番地です。NPCと: redirect requests a correction, and target supplies the address. These feed NPC and the PC MUX to update PC and discard younger instructions.
trap はトラップ要求、epc はRETIの戻り番地です。: trap requests a trap; epc is the RETI return address.
トラップを最優先してベクタ番地へ、RETIなら epc へ修正します。: A trap has highest priority and selects the vector address; RETI selects epc.
命令が持ってきた例外、データ側の例外、割り込みの順に判定します。例外では問題の命: Check carried exceptions, then data faults, then interrupts. Exceptions cancel the faulting instruction; interrupts allow the MEM instruction to complete first. Defer interrupts during memory waits or serializing instructions.
take はトラップ要求、fault は当該命令の効果も取り消す指示、cause: take requests the trap; fault cancels the current instruction’s effects; cause is the reason; epc is the resume address; badva is the faulting virtual address. They drive CSR capture and younger-instruction flushing.
exWrite は実行段のフラグ書き込み要求、kill はその命令を破棄する指示: exWrite requests an execution-stage flags write; kill discards that instruction.
exWrite = H でも kill = H なら書き込みを止めます。行き先修: Suppress the flags write when kill = H even if exWrite = H, preventing a discarded instruction from changing flags used later.
en はフラグレジスタの書き込み許可です。この回路自体はフラグの値を保存しません: en enables the flags register. This circuit does not itself store flag values.
restore はRETIによる保存フラグの復元要求です。: restore requests restoration of saved flags on RETI.

inval = H の立ち上がりでは、補充より優先して全行の有効ビットを消します: On an inval = H rising edge, clear all valid bits with priority over fill, forcing instructions to be fetched from main memory again after FENCEI.

req は転送要求、addr は語番地、we は読み書きの区別、wd は書き込む: req requests a transfer, addr is the word address, we selects reading or writing, and wd is the 16-bit write value. Receive one request chosen by the arbiter.
512語を保持し、同じ要求を設定クロック数だけ待たせます。番地や読み書きの種類が: Store 512 words and wait the configured clocks for a request. Restart the wait if its address or read/write type changes. Reads return two words aligned to an even address; writes update one addressed word on a ready = H rising edge.

op の上位2 bitから書き込み先、下位2 bitから通常の入力選択を求めます: Use the upper two opcode bits for the destination and the lower two for normal source selection. For PC writes, select zero at the MUX so the immediate becomes the target. JNC permits a jump only when cf = L.
sel はMUXの選択（0 A、1 B、2 IN、3 定数0）、enA・enB・: sel selects the MUX source: 0 A, 1 B, 2 IN, 3 constant zero. enA, enB, and enOut enable their registers; jump selects the jump target for the next PC.
a・b はA/Bレジスタの値、in は外部入力、sel はデコーダの選択番号です: a and b are the A/B register values, in is external input, and sel is the decoder’s selection index. Each data value is four bits.
sel が0なら a、1なら b、2なら in、3なら定数0を選びます。選択した: Select a for sel = 0, b for 1, in for 2, or constant zero for 3. Pass the chosen value unchanged, without addition or storage. Selecting zero lets the ALU produce an immediate value, as for an immediate MOV.

x はMUXが選んだ4 bitの値、im はROMから届く4 bitの即値です。: x is the four-bit value selected by the MUX; im is the four-bit immediate from ROM. TD4 has no operation selector: it always adds.

sum は下位4 bitの結果、cf は5番目の桁（キャリー）です。結果をどのレ: sum is the low four result bits; cf is the fifth bit (carry). The decoder and registers determine where and when the result is stored.

MOV A, 3 が A に3を保存するまで: How MOV A, 3 stores 3 in A
A に即値3を入れる命令を例に、信号の到着とクロックでの保存を分けて追います。: Follow an instruction that loads the immediate value 3 into A, distinguishing signal arrival from capture at a clock edge.
PC が持つ命令の番地を ROM に渡します。ROM はその場所の命令を読み、操: PC sends the instruction address to ROM. ROM reads that location and outputs the upper four bits describing the operation and the lower four bits holding the immediate value 3.
DECODER（命令の解読回路）が A への書き込みを許可し、MUX（入力の選択: DECODER enables writing to A and tells MUX, the input selector, to select zero. ALU, the adder, adds the immediate value 3 to that zero.
計算結果3が A の入力 d に届きます。この時点では A の保存値と出力 q: The result 3 reaches input d of A. Its stored value and output q do not change yet. On a separate path, NEXT PC prepares the next instruction address.
信号が安定した後のクロックで、A が3を保存して q に出し、PC も次の番地を: At a clock edge after signals settle, A stores 3 and outputs it on q, while PC stores the next address. These new outputs then propagate along the wires.
ADD r3, r1, r2 が 7 + 5 を計算するまで: How ADD r3, r1, r2 computes 7 + 5
r1 = 7、r2 = 5 とします。以下は1命令の中の因果関係で、各項目ごとに: Assume r1 = 7 and r2 = 5. These steps explain cause and effect within one instruction; they are not separate clock cycles. The result is stored at the final clock edge.
PC の番地にある命令を MEMORY が読み出します。FIELDS が命令から: MEMORY reads the instruction at the address in PC. FIELDS extracts source registers r1 and r2 and destination r3; CONTROL selects addition and enables writing.
REGISTERS（レジスタファイル）が r1 の7と r2 の5を出します。B: REGISTERS, the register file, outputs 7 from r1 and 5 from r2. B SRC selects r2 as the second input. ALU computes 7 + 5 when the two values arrive.
結果12が REGISTERS の書き込み入力 wd に戻り、計算結果の状態を表: The result 12 returns to write-data input wd of REGISTERS, while the flags describing the result reach FLAGS.
次のクロックで r3 に12を保存し、FLAGS にフラグを保存します。その後の: The next clock edge stores 12 in r3 and the flags in FLAGS. A later conditional branch uses PC SELECT to test those stored flags and select the next instruction address.
LD がメモリの値をレジスタへ運ぶまで: How LD moves a memory value into a register
LD r2, [r1+3] を例にします。r1 = 0x0080、メモリの番地: Consider LD r2, [r1+3]. If r1 = 0x0080 and memory location 0x0083 contains 42, the instruction loads 42 into r2.
FIELDS が命令から r1、保存先 r2、定数3を取り出します。REGIST: FIELDS extracts r1, destination r2, and the constant 3 from the instruction. REGISTERS outputs r1, and ADDR, the address adder, computes 0x0080 + 3 = 0x0083.
計算した番地が MEMORY のデータ用入力に届くと、その場所の値42が読み出し: When the address reaches the data input of MEMORY, its read output produces 42 from that location. This uses a separate port from the one reading the instruction itself.
WRITE BACK（保存する値の選択回路）がメモリから来た42を選び、REGI: WRITE BACK, the selector for the value to store, selects 42 from memory and sends it to the register file write input. Destination r2 and write enable arrive on separate wires.
入力が安定した後のクロックで r2 に42を保存します。値が入力へ届いただけでは: At the clock edge after the inputs settle, r2 stores 42. Arrival at the input alone does not change the stored value of r2.
関数を呼び出し、元の場所へ戻るまで: Calling a function and returning to the caller
JAL で、他の関数を呼ばない短い関数へ移り、RET で戻る場合です。r7 を戻: This example uses JAL to call a short function that makes no further calls, then RET to return. Register r7 serves as LR, the link register holding the return address.
JAL を解読すると、PC+1 が呼び出しの次の番地を計算し、TARGET が命: When JAL is decoded, PC+1 computes the address after the call and TARGET computes the function address from the instruction offset. The return address and call target are prepared separately.
WRITE BACK が戻り番地を選び、NEXT PC が関数の行き先を選びます: WRITE BACK selects the return address and NEXT PC selects the call target. At the clock edge, r7 stores the return address and PC stores the target, starting instruction fetch in the function.
関数は通常の命令で計算します。この例では r7 を上書きしません。さらに別の関数: The function computes using ordinary instructions without overwriting r7 in this example. To make another call, first save r7 to memory with ST, then restore it with LD after that call returns.
RET を解読すると、REGISTERS から r7 を読み、ADDR で0を加: When RET is decoded, REGISTERS reads r7 and ADDR adds zero to form the return target. The next clock edge stores that address in PC, resuming at the instruction after the call.
タイマの要求を受け、割り込み処理から戻るまで: Accepting a timer interrupt and returning
タイマの要求があり、CPU が割り込みを許可している場合を追います。割り込みを受: Follow a pending timer request when CPU interrupts are enabled. The accepting clock edge saves the state needed to return instead of completing the ordinary instruction.
TIMER が設定された周期に達すると、割り込み要求を出し続けます。TRAP（中: When TIMER reaches its configured period, it holds an interrupt request active. TRAP checks this request against the interrupt-enable state stored in CSR.
受け付けると決まると、WRITE GATE が通常の命令によるレジスタ・メモリ・: If the interrupt is accepted, WRITE GATE blocks the ordinary instruction from writing registers, memory, or flags. At the same time, NEXT PC selects interrupt-handler entry 0x0001.
クロックで CSR が戻り番地 EPC、原因 CAUSE、元の状態 ESTAT: At the clock edge, CSR saves return address EPC, cause CAUSE, and prior state ESTAT, and disables interrupts. PC stores 0x0001 so fetching starts at the handler.
割り込み処理はタイマの要求を消し、必要な仕事を行います。RETI のクロックで: The handler clears the timer request and performs the required work. At the RETI clock edge, EPC and ESTAT restore the address and state so execution resumes with the interrupted instruction.
LD を複数のクロックに分けて実行する: Executing LD across multiple clock cycles
LD r2, [r1+3] を例に、同じ ALU とメモリを順番に使います。以下: Use LD r2, [r1+3] to follow the same ALU and memory being reused in sequence. Clock edges advance the states below; a slow memory response keeps the current state active.
FETCH（命令の取得）では PC の番地をメモリへ渡します。応答がそろったクロ: FETCH sends the address in PC to memory. At an edge when the response is ready, IR stores the instruction and PC advances to the next address.
DECODE（命令の解読）では、REGISTERS から必要な値を読み、A・B: DECODE reads the required values from REGISTERS and captures them in temporary registers A and B. Later states can then use the value read from r1.
EXEC（計算）では ALU が r1 の値と定数3を加え、読み出す番地を作りま: EXEC uses ALU to add the value from r1 and the constant 3, producing the read address. A clock edge stores that address in ALUOUT.
MEM（データの読み出し）では ALUOUT の番地をメモリへ渡します。read: MEM sends the address in ALUOUT to memory, waits until ready is H, then captures the returned value in MDR at a clock edge.
MEMWB（レジスタへの保存）では WRITE BACK が MDR の値を選び: MEMWB selects the value in MDR through WRITE BACK and stores it in r2 at a clock edge. LD is complete, and processing returns to FETCH for the next instruction.
1命令を3段に分け、次の命令と重ねる: Overlapping instructions in a three-stage pipeline
IF は取得、DX は解読と計算、MW はメモリアクセスと保存です。以下は1命令: IF fetches, DX decodes and computes, and MW accesses memory and stores results. These steps follow one instruction, while the stages work on different instructions at the same time.
IF で PC の番地から命令を読みます。クロックで命令と番地情報を IF/DX: IF reads the instruction at PC. A clock edge stores the instruction and address information in the IF/DX stage register for the next stage.
DX で命令を解読し、REGISTERS から値を読み、ALU で計算します。計: DX decodes the instruction, reads REGISTERS, and computes with ALU. A clock edge stores the result together with its destination and write-enable signals in DX/MW.
MW では、LD なら計算した番地からデータを読み、ST ならその番地への書き込: MW reads the computed memory address for LD or prepares a write for ST. An enabled clock edge stores arithmetic or LD results in a register, or the ST value in memory.
その間に後続命令も前の段を進みます。後続の DX が先行する MW の結果を必要: Meanwhile, following instructions advance through earlier stages. If a later instruction in DX needs a result from MW, FORWARD selects a direct result path. With forwarding disabled, HAZARD makes it wait.
1命令が5段を通って結果を保存するまで: How an instruction passes through five pipeline stages
LD r2, [r1+3] を例にします。待ちや取り消しがなければ、クロックごと: Follow LD r2, [r1+3]. Without stalls or cancellation, each clock edge advances it to the next stage. Each stage works on a different instruction in parallel; this entire sequence is not one clock cycle.
IF（取得）はメモリから命令を読み、IF/ID に保存します。次のクロック間には: IF fetches the instruction from memory and stores it in IF/ID. In the next clock interval, IF can fetch a later instruction while ID handles this one.
